note: v1.0 frozen BEFORE experiments ran. v1.1 amends ONLY the measurement of R2/R6 (same rules, correct instruments); R1/R3/R4/R5/R7 untouched.

amendments.A1_R2_measurement: v1.0 compared candidate quadrants against HAND-COPIED base quadrant values that came from the WRONG instrument (v1 SGMC-RAW instead of SGMC-FAR). v1.1 evaluates the base mask IN-PROCESS with the same evaluator. Rule unchanged (>=3/4 quadrants non-negative). Root cause + proof: evidence/r2_fix_note.md.
amendments.A2_R6_lane_vs_carrier: The brief's duplicate rule targets drifting into ANOTHER LANE. Any improvement on the shared group base (including H33-2-B2 itself, a 100% subset of D2.8) trivially violates a full-mask overlap test, so v1.1 splits R6: R6a LANE-INDEPENDENCE (must pass: discovery-surface rank-rho <= 0.90 vs every registry raster AND novel added-dots 3px-overlap <= 0.70) and R6b CARRIER-DISCLOSURE (report-only: full-mast overlap + novel-dot fraction, so the weekly selector can diversify slots). Rationale: evidence/r6_note.md.

promotion_rules.R1_primary_win: SGMC-FAR pooled DTI margin vs base >= +0.0005
promotion_rules.R2_quadrant_consistency: SGMC-FAR per-quadrant DTI non-negative margin in >= 3 of 4 quadrants (base evaluated in-process)
promotion_rules.R3_no_loss_mid: SGMC-MID pooled DTI margin vs base >= -0.001
promotion_rules.R4_no_loss_raw: SGMC-RAW pooled DTI margin vs base >= -0.001
promotion_rules.R5_live_safety: live-anchored safety factor >= 2.0 for the removal part (budget=0.2*0.2778*dn_removed vs conservative SGMC-MID credit cost); additions capped at 1500 dots with SGMC-FAR credit/dot >= 0.111 (2x live bar under 50% transfer) or capped at 1000 dots otherwise
promotion_rules.R6a_lane_independence: discovery-surface rank-rho <= 0.90 vs EVERY registry raster AND novel added-dots 3px-overlap <= 0.70 vs EVERY registry raster
promotion_rules.R6b_carrier_disclosure: REPORT ONLY: full-mask rho/overlap vs registry + novel-dot fraction, published in the run card for the weekly selector
promotion_rules.R7_audit: 12/12 submission checks PASS on BOTH -zeros.tif and -nan.tif variants

live_anchor.kind: OWNER-REPORTED (prompt ledger; no organizer receipt on file)
